coverage_notes: Angle: Duke-alum emerging managers, solo GPs and micro-VC / pre-seed funds. This space looks largely covered already. Almost every generic Duke + fund-launch query (solo GP, debut fund, first close, Signal NFX, VC Lab, Kauffman, Fuqua and Duke Law GP, Duke I&E news, the DCP investor spotlights, the IWD 2024 Duke women list) returned only known people: Kevin King, the Front Porch trio, Greg Baker, Jason Fernandez, Grant Newlin, Lori Cashman, Cassie Young, Katelyn Donnelly, Kerstin Dittmar, Lindy Fishburne, Lisa Blau, Sydney Thomas, Logan Allin, Ted Wang, David Beisel, Dan Levitan, Salman Azhar, Deb Liu, Sergey Khusnetdinov, Nikhil Mittal (BlueRidge) and Ruby Grewal. Name checks on well-known AI and fintech solo GPs and emerging managers (Altman, Tunguz, Caruso, Sarah Smith, Goyal, Qadree, Rosenblatt) all turned out non-Duke. WebFetch was blocked for signal.nfx.com, entrepreneurship.duke.edu, masters.pratt.duke.edu and en.wikipedia.org, so everything rests on search snippets. Leads not resolved: (1) the Duke Pratt MEng FinTech advisory board page (https://masters.pratt.duke.edu/fintech/advisory-board/) likely lists Duke fintech investors but could not be read; (2) Packy McCormick (Not Boring Capital), Ross Fubini (XYZ VC) and Nik Milanovic (Fintech Fund) were searched together but the result was inconclusive, so their schools are unverified and they are NOT ruled out; (3) Harry Landis (Clara Vista Partners / TIA Ventures) and Vee Zhu appeared in a Duke/Fuqua result but were not checked. The 45-call budget includes one call rejected by the API for a disallowed domain; two calls also ran several internal sub-searches.
